# Carmine's Italiano

> Italian restaurant at 7170 Transit Road, Williamsville, NY 14221. Dine-in, take-out, catering and banquets. Family owned and operated by Kelly & Alex Jacobbi; opened in 1993.

## Essentials
- Phone: (716) 636-3100
- Hours: Wednesday–Sunday from 4pm; closed Monday and Tuesday. Closing times vary; holiday hours are posted on Google.
- History: opened in 1993; after a 2015 fire, reopened at 9430 Transit Road, East Amherst in 2017; at 7170 Transit Road, Williamsville since September 2022.
- Reservations: suggested for parties of 6 or more and on Fridays and Saturdays (call)
- Take-out specials (take-out only, feed 4–6): Big Bucket of Pasta $39.99 (4 meatballs, family-style salad with garlic parmesan dressing, half loaf of bread and olive butter); Chicken Parm Pack $64.99 (6 chicken parm, half tray baked ziti with carmine’s red and melted mozzarella, family-style salad with garlic parmesan dressing, half loaf of bread and olive butter)
- Catering: gatherings of 10 or more, delivered anywhere in the 716 area, seven days a week, afternoon through evening
- Drop-off catering packages: Standard $19.99 per person (pick 2 entrées, 2 sides & 1 salad); Deluxe $23.99 per person (pick 2 entrées, 2 sides, 1 salad & 1 appetizer). Full service party package $31.99 per person. Trays by the full or half.
- Banquets: private room seating 40. Standard Family Buffet $25.99 per person; Brunch $22.95 per person; Deluxe Buffet Package $42.99 per person.
